meta.title: Specialist Casting for Film, TV & Commercial | Take 3 Agency
meta.description: Specialist casting from Take 3 Agency: stunt performers and doubles, circus and physical artists, unique talent and intimacy coordinators, plus anything else a brief calls for beyond the standing roster.
meta.ogDescription: When a brief calls for a skill or a look beyond the standing roster, Take 3 sources it.

items.name: Stunt performers & doubles
items.description: Action-trained talent and matched doubles, cleared for the sequence and safe on the day.
items.imageAlt: A soldier in full kit thrown to the ground on a smoke-filled street, a building burning behind him.

items.name: Circus & physical
items.description: Aerialists, acrobats and physical performers, trained to performance standard.
items.imageAlt: A circus performer in a rigged studio space.

items.name: Unique talent
items.description: Performers whose look is the reason they are cast: height, stature, twins and memorable faces.
items.imageAlt: A black-and-white studio portrait of a performer with tattooed arms and painted eyes, hands raised to the face.

items.name: Intimacy
items.description: Certified coordinators and intimacy-trained performers, for content handled properly.
items.imageAlt: A black-and-white studio photograph of a tattooed performer from behind, arms arched over their head.

examples.heading: Whatever the brief calls for
examples.intro: The divisions are the briefs we are asked for most often, not the limit of who we represent. All of these are on our books and booked regularly, and if the scene calls for something else, tell us and we will find it.

items.name: Footballers
items.body: Semi-professional footballers who can play the game on camera, not just look the part.

items.name: Skateboarders
items.body: Skateboarders who can land the trick take after take, for commercials and film.

items.name: Athletes
items.body: Trained athletes across track, field and gym, cast for the sport and the physique the scene calls for.

items.name: Creature performers
items.body: Performers who work under prosthetics, suits and puppetry, with credits on productions like Beetlejuice and Star Wars.

items.name: Motion capture
items.body: Performance-capture artists who have worked on high-end AAA games.

items.name: Drivers and riders
items.body: Precision drivers and motorbike and horse riders for action on the road and on set.
